name: World's Largest Caterpillar
claim: Joined dome buildings shaped like a caterpillar, billed as the world's largest; beside northbound I-35E at mile marker 387.

name: Pioneer Plaza Cattle Drive
claim: Bronze cattle drive with cowboys, described as the largest bronze monument of its kind in the world.
address: Pioneer Plaza, next to the convention center, downtown Dallas, TX

name: Athena at the Parthenon
claim: A 42-foot gilded Athena inside a full-scale Parthenon replica, the tallest indoor statue in the U.S.
